detections.diagnosis: Heavy snow layer blocking incident solar irradiance across module array.
detections.recommended_action: Allow solar thermal melting if ambient temp > 2°C, or deploy soft-edged snow rake. Never use chemical de-icers.

sop: 1. Monitor ambient and cell temperature forecasts.
2. Clear bottom edge framing to allow natural snow shedding.
3. Utilize soft-edged telescopic silicone snow rake if necessary.
4. Strictly avoid salt, hot water, or sharp metal scrapers.
